discourse_reference.note: Every mapped key exists in client.en.yml at both revisions with an equivalent English value; semantic equivalence reviewed per key (field 'verified').

rules: Site texts (source schema 3): every 'fomio' key is a Discourse translation key ('site_text_key', fomio_app.<key with '.' as '__'>) in the plugin's config/locales/fomio_app.<locale>.yml, generated by Localization/tools/site-texts.rb from the bundled English and Localization/catalogs/<locale>.json. A 'discourse' key's site text is its 'discourse_key'. Administrators override either in Admin > Customize > Text.
English (en): the app's bundled English; a valid same-locale (en) override of the key's site text replaces it.

Other locales, per key: (1) that locale's own override of the key's site text, when valid; (2) that locale's own translation: Discourse's client translation of 'discourse_key' (no fallback) or the plugin's fomio_app.<locale>.yml; (3) otherwise English as served, listed in the catalog's 'fallback' array. A plural override is that locale's per-category overrides (key.one, key.other, ...) over its own translation.
Reuse only semantically equivalent Discourse keys, verified per key with context (field 'verified'); never map on equal wording alone and never substitute words.

A missing or invalid value (markup, raw key, wrong placeholders, plural form outside the locale's categories, missing 'other' or 'other' without {count}) is skipped for the next candidate; English is last. Deprecated overrides are ignored; outdated ones are served and counted.

Plural categories per locale come from Discourse's CLDR rules (I18n 'i18n.plural.keys'); a plural message needs 'other' and may use only those categories; a missing selected form shows 'other', as in Discourse. Fallback (English) plural messages use English rules.
Convert Discourse %{name} to {name}, renaming per the entry's 'placeholders' map. Never apply an override from one locale to another.

terminology.decision: Native interface nouns default to 'discussion' (topic) and 'community' (category/subcategory) in every locale. Branding is adopted by overriding whole sentences, never by word substitution: overrides of the keys in 'keys' are ignored until the plugin setting fomio_app_terminology_overrides is on, which declares the set complete. The web's topic/category overrides (js.topic.*, js.category.*) stay unmapped.
terminology.evidence: Public /extra-locales/<digest>/en/overrides.js on 2026-10-15 (inspected, not used by the app): topic keys -> Byte/Bytes, category keys -> Hub, subcategory keys -> Teret/terets; inconsistent casing (js.topic.new = 'new byte' vs js.topic.create = 'New Byte'); js.category.all overridden to the literal key 'js.hubs.all'. Only English has overrides.
